Hands reach in to retrieve the cups. The lighting is bright and warm, emphasizing the packaging details. A small white plastic spoon scoops into each cup, showing a dense and creamy consistency. The setting appears to be an outdoor patio with natural daylight. (5) A larger rectangular white foam container is opened on a black metallic table. Inside is a large volume of light pink strawberry-speckled gelato. A silver spoon carves out a generous scoop, highlighting the frozen texture and fruit inclusions. The lighting is bright natural daylight. (6) The final shot is a wide view of a storefront with glass doors and a purple banner displaying black text. A menu is visible on the wall next to the entrance. The building is located on a clean urban street under overcast natural light.
